title: Mail
emptyDescription: Messages will appear here when they arrive.
selectDescription: Your conversations, all in one place.
subject: Subject
deleteConfirm: Permanently remove the selected messages from the mailbox?
queuedNotice: Queued. Sending starts within a minute.
queuedDescription: Emails are processed in the background. Check the outbox for failures.
attachmentsTooLarge: Attachments exceed the 10 MB total limit.
imagesBlocked: External images are blocked for privacy.
noAccounts: Add a Resend mailbox in Settings → Email management to get started.
name: Name
secretHint: Leave blank to keep the saved secret. Stored credentials are encrypted.
webhookCurrentBase: Current backend callback base URL (full mailbox URLs appear below)
webhookSetupSteps: Save the mailbox and API key first, then copy its full callback URL. In Resend → Webhooks → Add Webhook, paste it into Endpoint URL and select the events listed below. Copy the new Signing secret (whsec_…), return here, edit the mailbox, and save it under Webhook signing secret.
webhookSaveFirst: Save the mailbox to generate its unique full callback URL. Leave the signing secret empty for now, then edit it after creating the Resend webhook.
webhookLocalWarning: Resend requires a backend HTTPS URL reachable from the public internet. Localhost, 127.0.0.1, and private addresses cannot receive callbacks directly. For local development, use an HTTPS tunnel, set MAIL_PUBLIC_URL to its URL, and restart the backend.
webhookEvents: Subscribe to: email.received, email.sent, email.delivered, email.delivery_delayed, email.failed, email.bounced, email.complained, email.suppressed. For open and click statistics, also select email.opened and email.clicked.
webhookCopyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the callback URL manually.
webhookHint: In Resend, enable receiving for your domain and configure this endpoint for email.received and delivery events. Use an API key with receiving access. Set MAIL_PUBLIC_URL to your public backend URL.
contactImport: One contact per line: email,name. A CSV file with email,name headers is also supported.
consent: These contacts have opted in to marketing emails
audienceHint: Send individually to subscribed, unsuppressed contacts. Each email includes an unsubscribe link.
startCampaignConfirm: Queue this campaign for {{audience}}? Emails will be sent automatically.
emptyContacts: Add contacts to your address book
requestFailed: Unable to complete the request. Check your connection and try again.
accountDisabled: This mailbox is disabled or has no API key.
accountBusy: Pause active campaigns and clear the outbox before disabling this mailbox.
encryptionRequired: Set MAIL_ENCRYPTION_KEY or a secure COOKIE_SECRET on the backend first.
publicUrlRequired: Configure MAIL_PUBLIC_URL with your public backend origin.
draftOnly: Only drafts can be edited or sent.
messageIncomplete: Enter a recipient, subject and message.
messageNotFound: One of the selected messages no longer exists.
messageBusy: Wait for sending to finish before moving this message.
trashOnly: Only messages in the trash can be restored or permanently deleted.
retryFailedOnly: Only failed outbox messages can be retried.
retryExpired: The safe retry window has expired. Check delivery with Resend before sending again.
consentRequired: Provide the source of marketing consent.
noRecipients: No eligible subscribed contacts were found.
campaignState: This action is not available for the campaign's current status.
attachmentUnavailable: The attachment could not be retrieved. Try again later.
invalidRecipients: Enter valid email addresses separated by commas.
invalidCsv: Check your CSV: each row must contain a valid email address and an optional name.
unsaved: Changes are saved automatically to drafts.
deliveryHelp: Sent means accepted by Resend. Delivered means confirmed by the receiving server. Open/click statistics require tracking in Resend.
deliveryFailed: Resend could not accept or deliver this email. Check the mailbox settings and delivery records before retrying.
